title: Elsinore Camo TC-3

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Built for aggressive dirt performance, the Icon Elsinore Camo TC-3 is crafted for intense dirt riding with ultra-wide goggle eyeport stabilization across punishing tracks and trails. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell tips the scales at 1456g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~99 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.06 impact standards. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Vintage MX styling meets modern composite construction and safety.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Icon Elsinore Camo TC-3 is a dirt/MX specific helmet designed for off-road motocross and enduro riding. It features a multi-density EPS liner for impact absorption and is optimized for ventilation in high-intensity environments.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Icon Elsinore Camo TC-3: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Icon Elsinore Camo TC-3: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Icon Elsinore Camo TC-3. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Icon Elsinore Camo TC-3 is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.

ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

introduction: Positioned in Icon's Dirt / MX lineup, the Elsinore Camo TC-3 brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Icon Elsinore Camo TC-3 represents Icon's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~99 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Icon Elsinore Camo TC-3 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
